endorsements.name: László Gyaraki
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-1777
endorsements.description: Agent names that participates in a chat conversation are revealed in certain parts of the external interface as well as in chat transcriptions inside the tickets, when system is configured to mask real agent names. This issue affects OTRS; 7.0.21 and prior versions, 8.0.6 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)
